drafts.lead: Marco R. Sousa, President CL Wizard — specialised service, wins work via referrals and consulting engineers, open if we have building owners
drafts.body:
Marco,

That is a useful thing to know, and it changes what I would suggest rather than ruling it out.

Referrals and consulting engineers are the right channel for specialised remedial work, and nothing we do replaces that. What outbound adds is the building owners who have the problem but have not yet been routed to anyone. They are the ones searching for a fix, calling the wrong contractor, or living with the leak because they do not know it is solvable.

So the campaign I would run for CL Wizard is not a volume play. It is a narrow list of owners and property managers with the kind of concrete structures where infiltration recurs, and the message would be specific enough that only someone with the actual problem replies.

Worth twenty minutes to work out what that list looks like:

• Monday, August 17 at 1:30 PM EDT
• Tuesday, August 18 at 2:00 PM EDT
• Wednesday, August 19 at 1:30 PM EDT

Sarah

drafts.lead: Margarete, Be Belong — said relevant, redirected to Bella Cohen who leads integration, offered a RentGain.AI demo
drafts.body:
Margarete,

Thank you, that is helpful. I will write to Bella directly.

One thing worth clarifying before I do, so she is not expecting the wrong conversation. We are not looking to join the platform ourselves. What we would do for Be Belong is run outbound to multifamily owners and operators on your behalf, so the ones who should be seeing a RentGain.AI demo come to Bella rather than her having to find them.

If that is the right conversation, I will take it to her. If the integration effort is the priority right now and new owner conversations are not, tell me and I will come back later instead.

Amy
